title.zh: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Tops JPMorgan’s Ten-Year Forecast for All Assets
title.en: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Tops JPMorgan’s Ten-Year Forecast for All Assets

current_state.zh: JPMorgan Asset Management's newly released 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions ranks Bitcoin first among thirteen asset classes with a projected 10% annualized return over 10-15 years, ahead of REITs, small caps, U.S. large caps and gold.
current_state.en: JPMorgan Asset Management's newly released 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions ranks Bitcoin first among thirteen asset classes with a projected 10% annualized return over 10-15 years, ahead of REITs, small caps, U.S. large caps and gold.
